# ketanjoshi02.github.io
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>Zayka – The Taste of Bharat</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"/>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,700;0,900;1,700&family=Cinzel:wght@600;700&family=Hind:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js"></script>
  <style>
    :root{--saffron:#F5A623;--deep-saffron:#E8732A;--rust:#C0430A;--brown:#3D1A00;--dark-brown:#2A0E00;--cream:#FFF8ED;--light-orange:#FFE4B5;--white:#FFFFFF;--green:#2D6A4F;--shadow:rgba(61,26,0,.18)}
    *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
    body{font-family:'Hind',sans-serif;background:var(--cream);color:var(--brown);overflow-x:hidden}

    /* HERO */
    .hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--saffron) 0%,var(--deep-saffron) 55%,var(--rust) 100%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:2rem 1.5rem 4rem;overflow:hidden}
    .hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;width:420px;height:420px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);top:-80px;left:-120px;pointer-events:none}
    .hero::after{content:'';position:absolute;width:300px;height:300px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(61,26,0,.12);bottom:-60px;right:-80px;pointer-events:none}
    .mandala-ring{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);animation:spin 30s linear infinite}
    .mandala-ring.r1{width:200px;height:200px;top:5%;left:5%}
    .mandala-ring.r2{width:150px;height:150px;bottom:10%;right:8%;animation-direction:reverse;animation-duration:20s}
    @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

    .hero-logo{width:130px;height:130px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:4px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(61,26,0,.4);margin-bottom:1rem;animation:fadeUp .5s ease both}
    .hero-badge{background:var(--brown);color:var(--saffron);font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.25em;padding:.4rem 1.2rem;border-radius:50px;margin-bottom:.8rem;text-transform:uppercase;animation:fadeUp .6s .05s ease both;display:inline-block}
    .hero-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:clamp(3.5rem,12vw,8rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--white);line-height:.9;text-shadow:4px 6px 20px rgba(61,26,0,.35);animation:fadeUp .7s .1s ease both;letter-spacing:-.02em}
    .hero-sub{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1rem,3vw,1.4rem);color:var(--light-orange);margin-top:.75rem;animation:fadeUp .7s .2s ease both;letter-spacing:.05em}
    .hero-divider{width:80px;height:3px;background:var(--white);margin:1rem auto;border-radius:2px;animation:fadeUp .7s .3s ease both}
    .hero-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.4rem;animation:fadeUp .7s .35s ease both}
    .hero-address{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);font-size:.9rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;justify-content:center}
    .hero-hours{background:rgba(61,26,0,.35);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);color:var(--light-orange);font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;padding:.35rem 1.2rem;border-radius:50px;letter-spacing:.08em;display:inline-block}
    .hero-desc{max-width:480px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.7;animation:fadeUp .7s .4s ease both}
    .scroll-hint{position:absolute;bottom:2rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;animation:bounce 2s infinite}
    .scroll-hint::after{content:'↓';display:block;text-align:center;font-size:1.2rem}
    @keyframes bounce{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(6px)}}
    @keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

    /* LANG TOGGLE */
    .lang-bar{background:var(--dark-brown);display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;padding:.6rem 1.2rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .lang-label{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-right:.3rem}
    .lang-btn{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid rgba(245,166,35,.4);color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.05em;padding:.3rem .8rem;border-radius:50px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;font-family:'Hind',sans-serif}
    .lang-btn:hover,.lang-btn.active{background:var(--saffron);border-color:var(--saffron);color:var(--brown)}

    /* STICKY NAV */
    .sticky-nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;background:var(--brown);display:flex;gap:0;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;box-shadow:0 3px 14px var(--shadow)}
    .sticky-nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
    .nav-item{flex:0 0 auto;padding:.9rem 1.2rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-size:.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .2s;border-bottom:3px solid transparent}
    .nav-item:hover,.nav-item.active{color:var(--saffron);border-bottom-color:var(--saffron)}

    /* SECTIONS */
    .menu-section{padding:4rem 1.5rem;max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto}
    .section-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:2.5rem}
    .section-tag{display:inline-block;background:var(--saffron);color:var(--brown);font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.3rem 1rem;border-radius:50px;margin-bottom:.6rem}
    .section-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,4vw,2.4rem);color:var(--brown);font-weight:700}
    .section-line{width:50px;height:3px;background:var(--deep-saffron);margin:.75rem auto 0;border-radius:2px}
    .band{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--brown) 0%,var(--rust) 50%,var(--brown) 100%);height:6px}

    /* CARDS */
    .card-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:1rem}
    .menu-card{background:var(--white);border-radius:14px;padding:1.1rem 1.3rem;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border:1.5px solid rgba(245,166,35,.2);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
    .menu-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:4px;height:100%;background:var(--saffron);border-radius:4px 0 0 4px}
    .menu-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(232,115,42,.15)}
    .card-name{font-size:.95rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--brown);padding-right:.5rem}
    .card-price{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--rust);white-space:nowrap;background:#fff3e0;padding:.25rem .6rem;border-radius:8px}

    /* THALI */
    .thali-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:1.5rem}
    .thali-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brown) 0%,var(--dark-brown) 100%);border-radius:18px;padding:1.8rem;color:var(--white);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
    .thali-card::after{content:'';position:absolute;width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(245,166,35,.1);bottom:-40px;right:-40px}
    .thali-name{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--saffron);margin-bottom:.5rem}
    .thali-price-badge{display:inline-block;background:var(--saffron);color:var(--brown);font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.4rem;padding:.2rem .9rem;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:.8rem}
    .thali-includes{font-size:.82rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);line-height:1.6}

    /* NOTES */
    .notes-box{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff3e0,#ffe0b2);border:2px solid var(--saffron);border-radius:14px;padding:1.5rem 2rem;max-width:600px;margin:3rem auto 0}
    .notes-box h3{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--rust);margin-bottom:.8rem}
    .notes-box ul{list-style:none;padding:0}
    .notes-box ul li{padding:.3rem 0;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--brown);padding-left:1.2rem;position:relative}
    .notes-box ul li::before{content:'✦';position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--saffron);font-size:.7rem;top:.4rem}

    /* QR */
    .qr-section{background:var(--brown);padding:4rem 1.5rem;text-align:center}
    .qr-section h2{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,4vw,2rem);color:var(--saffron);margin-bottom:.5rem}
    .qr-section p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:1.8rem}
    .qr-wrapper{display:inline-block;background:var(--white);border-radius:16px;padding:1.2rem;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(245,166,35,.25)}
    #qr-code canvas,#qr-code img{border-radius:8px;display:block}
    .qr-caption{color:var(--saffron);font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:1rem}

    /* CONTACT */
    .contact-bar{background:var(--dark-brown);padding:2rem 1.5rem;text-align:center}
    .contact-bar p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);font-size:.8rem;margin-bottom:.5rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
    .contact-links{display:flex;gap:1.5rem;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .contact-links a{color:var(--saffron);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;transition:opacity .2s}
    .contact-links a:hover{opacity:.75}
    footer{background:#1a0800;text-align:center;padding:1.2rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);font-size:.75rem}

    /* VEG DOT */
    .veg-dot{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border:2px solid var(--green);border-radius:2px;position:relative;margin-right:4px;vertical-align:middle;flex-shrink:0}
    .veg-dot::after{content:'';position:absolute;width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--green);border-radius:50%;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}

    .alt-bg{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff8ed 0%,#fff3e0 100%)}

    /* REVEAL */
    .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:opacity .5s ease,transform .5s ease}
    .reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}

    @media(max-width:640px){.card-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.thali-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.menu-section{padding:2.5rem 1rem}.notes-box{padding:1.2rem}}
    @media(min-width:768px){.card-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
    @media(min-width:1024px){.card-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}

    /* HIDDEN LANG CONTENT */
    [data-lang]{display:none}
    .lang-en [data-lang="en"],[data-lang="en"].lang-en-inline{display:inline}
    .lang-hi [data-lang="hi"],[data-lang="hi"].lang-hi-inline{display:inline}
    .lang-gu [data-lang="gu"],[data-lang="gu"].lang-gu-inline{display:inline}
  </style>
</head>
<body class="lang-en">


<!-- LANG BAR -->
<div class="lang-bar">
  <span class="lang-label">Language:</span>
  <button class="lang-btn active" onclick="setLang('en')">English</button>
  <button class="lang-btn" onclick="setLang('hi')">हिन्दी</button>
  <button class="lang-btn" onclick="setLang('gu')">ગુજરાતી</button>
</div>

<!-- HERO -->
<section class="hero">
  <div class="mandala-ring r1"></div>
  <div class="mandala-ring r2"></div>
  <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," class="hero-logo" alt="Zayka Logo"/>
  <div class="hero-badge">By J.B. Food</div>
  <h1 class="hero-title">ZAYKA</h1>
  <p class="hero-sub">
    <span data-lang="en">The Taste of Bharat</span>
    <span data-lang="hi">भारत का स्वाद</span>
    <span data-lang="gu">ભારતનો સ્વાદ</span>
  </p>
  <div class="hero-divider"></div>
  <div class="hero-info">
    <div class="hero-address">📍
      <span data-lang="en">Inside Ultratech Cement Ltd., Sewagram</span>
      <span data-lang="hi">अल्ट्राटेक सीमेंट लिमिटेड के अंदर, सेवाग्राम</span>
      <span data-lang="gu">અલ્ટ્રાટેક સીમેન્ટ લિ. ની અંદર, સેવાગ્રામ</span>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-hours">🕐
      <span data-lang="en">Open 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM IST</span>
      <span data-lang="hi">खुलने का समय: सुबह 11 – रात 11 बजे</span>
      <span data-lang="gu">સવારે 11 – રાત 11 IST સુધી ખુલ્લું રહેશે</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-desc" style="margin-top:.8rem">
    <span data-lang="en">Authentic flavours of India — from sizzling street snacks to royal thalis, all made with love and tradition.</span>
    <span data-lang="hi">भारत के असली स्वाद — चटपटे स्ट्रीट स्नैक्स से लेकर शाही थाली तक, सब कुछ प्यार और परंपरा से बना।</span>
    <span data-lang="gu">ભારતના સાચા સ્વાદ — તીખા સ્ટ્રીટ સ્નૅક્સથી શાહી થાળી સુધી, બધું પ્રેમ અને પરંપરાથી.</span>
  </div>
  <div class="scroll-hint">
    <span data-lang="en">Explore the menu</span>
    <span data-lang="hi">मेनू देखें</span>
    <span data-lang="gu">મેનૂ જુઓ</span>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- STICKY NAV -->
<nav class="sticky-nav" id="main-nav">
  <div class="nav-item" onclick="scrollToSection('soup')"><span data-lang="en">Soup</span><span data-lang="hi">सूप</span><span data-lang="gu">સૂપ</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item" onclick="scrollToSection('papad')"><span data-lang="en">Papad &amp; Salad</span><span data-lang="hi">पापड़ &amp; सलाद</span><span data-lang="gu">પાપડ &amp; સૅલૅડ</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item" onclick="scrollToSection('northeast')"><span data-lang="en">Indo-Chinese</span><span data-lang="hi">इंडो-चाइनीज़</span><span data-lang="gu">ઇન્ડો-ચાઇનીઝ</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item" onclick="scrollToSection('paneer')"><span data-lang="en">Paneer</span><span data-lang="hi">पनीर</span><span data-lang="gu">પનીર</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item" onclick="scrollToSection('veg')"><span data-lang="en">Veg Khajana</span><span data-lang="hi">वेज खज़ाना</span><span data-lang="gu">વેજ ખઝાના</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item" onclick="scrollToSection('kaju')"><span data-lang="en">Kaju</span><span data-lang="hi">काजू</span><span data-lang="gu">કાજુ</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item" onclick="scrollToSection('roti')"><span data-lang="en">Roti</span><span data-lang="hi">रोटी</span><span data-lang="gu">રોટી</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item" onclick="scrollToSection('dal')"><span data-lang="en">Dal &amp; Rice</span><span data-lang="hi">दाल &amp; चावल</span><span data-lang="gu">દાળ &amp; ભાત</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item" onclick="scrollToSection('pizza')">Pizza</div>
  <div class="nav-item" onclick="scrollToSection('burgers')"><span data-lang="en">Burgers</span><span data-lang="hi">बर्गर</span><span data-lang="gu">બર્ગર</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item" onclick="scrollToSection('drinks')"><span data-lang="en">Drinks</span><span data-lang="hi">पेय</span><span data-lang="gu">પીણાં</span></div>
  <div class="nav-item" onclick="scrollToSection('thali')"><span data-lang="en">Thali</span><span data-lang="hi">थाली</span><span data-lang="gu">થાળી</span></div>
</nav>

  <div class="card-grid">

    <div class="menu-card"><div><span class="veg-dot"></span><span class="card-name">Manchurian Soup</span></div><span class="card-price">₹100</span></div>

</section>

</section>

<!-- PANEER -->

<section class="menu-section alt-bg reveal">
  <div class="section-header">
    <span class="section-tag">Signature</span>
    <h2 class="section-title">Paneer Ke Sath</h2>
    <div class="section-line"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="card-grid">
    <div class="menu-card"><div><span class="veg-dot"></span><span class="card-name">Tikka Masala</span></div><span class="card-price">₹140</span></div>
    <div class="menu-card"><div><span class="veg-dot"></span><span class="card-name">Lababdar</span></div><span class="card-price">₹140</span></div>
    <div class="menu-card"><div><span class="veg-dot"></span><span class="card-name">Matter Masala</span></div><span class="card-price">₹140</span></div>
    <div class="menu-card"><div><span class="veg-dot"></span><span class="card-name">Butter Masala</span></div><span class="card-price">₹150</span></div>
    <div class="menu-card"><div><span class="veg-dot"></span><span class="card-name">Kadai Paneer</span></div><span class="card-price">₹160</span></div>
    <div class="menu-card"><div><span class="veg-dot"></span><span class="card-name">Paneer Handi</span></div><span class="card-price">₹150</span></div>
    <div class="menu-card"><div><span class="veg-dot"></span><span class="card-name">Bhurji</span></div><span class="card-price">₹160</span></div>
    <div class="menu-card"><div><span class="veg-dot"></span><span class="card-name">Paneer Balti</span></div><span class="card-price">₹160</span></div>
    <div class="menu-card"><div><span class="veg-dot"></span><span class="card-name">Shahi Paneer</span></div><span class="card-price">₹160</span></div>
    <div class="menu-card"><div><span class="veg-dot"></span><span class="card-name">Paneer Toofani</span></div><span class="card-price">₹180</span></div>

<footer>
  © Zayka – The Taste of Bharat &nbsp;|&nbsp; By J.B. Food &nbsp;|&nbsp; Inside Ultratech Cement Ltd., Sewagram &nbsp;|&nbsp; <span style="color:#F5A623">🍃 100% Vegetarian</span>
</footer>

<script>
  // QR Code
  const MENU_URL = window.location.href.startsWith('file:')
    ? 'https://zayka-jbfood.in'
    : window.location.href;
  new QRCode(document.getElementById("qr-code"),{text:MENU_URL,width:200,height:200,colorDark:"#3D1A00",colorLight:"#ffffff",correctLevel:QRCode.CorrectLevel.H});

  // Language switcher
  function setLang(lang){
    document.body.className='lang-'+lang;
    document.querySelectorAll('.lang-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.lang-btn').forEach(b=>{if(b.textContent.trim()==={en:'English',hi:'हिन्दी',gu:'ગુજરાતી'}[lang])b.classList.add('active')});
  }

  // Scroll reveal
  const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('visible')}),{threshold:.08});
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));

  function scrollToSection(id){const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})}

  const sectionIds=['soup','papad','northeast','paneer','veg','kaju','roti','dal','pizza','burgers','drinks','thali'];
  const navItems=document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
  const navObs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){const idx=sectionIds.indexOf(e.target.id);navItems.forEach(n=>n.classList.remove('active'));if(idx>=0)navItems[idx].classList.add('active')}})},{threshold:.5});
  sectionIds.forEach(id=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)navObs.observe(el)});
</script>
</body>
</html>
